justification: Loads seven state heritage-area outlines and their union, adds two keying and two gate rules, and widens DQ-146. Already written with the user's yes: 42 C-B 4.3 rules now reach only their heritage areas, 26 C-B 4.2 rules only heritage properties, and 3 C-B 4.4 rules are shown instead of reaching no house.

pre_impl.existing_data: Measured 2026-10-11: chapter 4.3 lists seven HCAs on p4; the state heritage layer holds exactly seven conservation areas for Canterbury-Bankstown LEP 2023 (OBJECTID 186983-187037). 33 served rows sat in v2_dcp_layer 'heritage', a layer for-property never queries.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The resume plan said the Ku-ring-gai centre outlines 14A-G were already loaded; only 14B's four sub-precincts are, and the state Local Provisions layer has none, so those centres are not in this change. DQ-146 as first written counted only the condition layer and missed the 'heritage' layer.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New loader because the importers that loaded Woollahra and Parramatta HCAs from the same state layer no longer run; keying reuses derive_precinct_keys (rules spliced from gate_rules.py because that file is at its 500-line limit).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The loader refuses if the chapter's list is not on page 4, a listed name matches zero or several state areas, or the state layer holds an eighth area. DQ-146 exits 1 while any served row sits where no route query returns it.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: DQ-146 read 33 after widening and before the write; 0 after. The centre-boundary test failed when the new constant rules appeared and was narrowed to the centre rules by name; the gate-rules real-DB test wrongly required an applied idempotent rule to still match rows and now checks the chapter exists.

functions.name: prove
functions.input: the state layer's conservation-area features for Canterbury-Bankstown LEP 2023
functions.output: checks 1-3 and a map from each listed name to its single matching state feature
functions.if_none: A name with no or several matches is left out of the map and check 2 fails, so nothing is written.

values.what: DQ-146 served rows reaching no house, after widening
values.read_at: Production, read-only, before and after the write on 2026-10-11

queries.purpose: Fetch the conservation-area outlines the state layer holds for Canterbury-Bankstown LEP 2023.
queries.where_clause: EPI_NAME = 'Canterbury-Bankstown Local Environmental Plan 2023' AND LAY_CLASS LIKE 'Conservation Area%'

break_it.scenario: Fetching the conservation-area outlines returns an extra or renamed area for the LEP.
break_it.what_happens: A wrong outline could be keyed to the chapter's rules.
break_it.how: Check 3 requires exactly seven areas and check 2 requires each listed name to match exactly one.

break_it.scenario: Section 21 refs are keyed to all seven areas instead of Ashbury.
break_it.what_happens: Ashbury-only controls would reach the Hurlstone Park HCAs.
break_it.how: test_cb_4_3_section_21_goes_to_ashbury_and_the_rest_to_all_seven checks the regex on real ref shapes.

break_it.scenario: A rule is parked in a layer the route never reads.
break_it.how: DQ-146 now counts any layer outside generic/use_specific/condition/precinct and is declared fixed, so CI fails on a return.

post_merge.db_reset: Done with the user's yes before merge: bash scripts/apply_cb_heritage_areas.sh (8 outline rows, 42 keys, 29 gate rows; backups in data/db_rollback_backups).
post_merge.manual_verify: DQ-146 0 and DQ-143 364 after the write; 56 unit tests and 3 real-source tests pass. Limit: chapter 4.4 'vicinity' has no land layer and is shown council-wide.
